1.name: Field Worker

effects.text: Choose a land in play. Gain its production as resources.

1.text: {activated} Choose a land in play. Gain its production as resources.
1.helpText: You may discard this card to gain the resources that a land (green banner) in play can produce. This doesn't discard that land. This does not include resources that that land can gain through Activated Effects, only the actual production. However, if an effect says that the land produces more resources, those are also gained when using this card.

4.name: Storage

effects.text: End of Turn: Discard to make another card stay in play.

4.text: {passive} Stays in play. {triggeredOptional} End of Turn: Discard to make another card stay in play.
4.helpText:
VERSION NOTE: This previously did not give any fame.
This card stays in play until you want to use it. It may discard itself to let another card stay in play instead.

description: The red arrows at the top of this card means that when you discover it, you must choose which of its 2 sides should be face up (the serial number must be at the top of this card, whichever side you choose). Choose wisely, since you cannot change this later. A Storage will help you with storage, and the Field Worker will work in the field. You're welcome!
